# authwise_access_role_access_permissions (Resource)

Manages the full set of access permissions associated with one access role. The set is authoritative: members associated out of band are removed on the next apply.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `access_permissions` (Set of String) Full resource names of the associated access permissions.
- `access_role` (String) Full resource name of the access role.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by full resource name.
# The role's full resource name. The member set fills in on the next refresh.
terraform import authwise_access_role_access_permissions.example tenants/t-01/issuers/i-01/audiences/a-01/access-roles/guardcontrol.admin
```
